entries.prompt: Correct ONLY the small red-lens temple module of the SECOND isolated bronze PHG2021 Falconer mask, using the FIRST official publisher screenshot as the authority. The existing candidate erroneously has FIVE red lenses. The actual source has exactly THREE small red lenses arranged in a compact TRIANGLE inside the same source module on image-left. Replace the five-dot arrangement with exactly three physical lens dots in that source triangle. Do not add a fourth/fifth lens,extra holes,glow,emitter or new hardware. Keep the existing housing,its placement,angle,size and silhouette unchanged. Preserve all other mask geometry,exact near-front inclined source camera,projected proportions,crown points,dark bronze/copper/gunmetal palette,eye inserts,beak ridges,cheeks,wear and source lighting exactly as SECOND. No other redesign,texture repair or geometry adjustment. Exclude wearer biology,dreads,neck,body,armor,shoulder weapon and scene. Exactly one complete isolated rigid mask,genuine transparent RGBA,whole crown/chin visible,10percent clear transparent margins,largest axis78-80percent canvas. No background,floor,shadow plane,text or UI. This is only a precise count/placement correction of the source-visible three physical red lenses.

rejectedAttempts.prompt: Isolate ONLY the rigid metallic mask worn by the SINGLE character in this official PHG publisher screenshot, keeping the same exact slightly inclined, near-frontal three-quarter camera and projected proportions. This is the source-visible 2021 game edition, not a reconstruction from a film or another existing project mask. Keep the whole source mask: broad rounded slightly oval bronze/dark gunmetal crown, the existing two small raised crown edge points/notches, the same dark eye lens inserts/apertures, the long narrow pointed central beak/muzzle with its existing raised grooves, tapered cheek plates, and the small physical temple module with its visible red lens dots on image-left. Keep the actual asymmetric source widths and downward pitch; do not invent a symmetrical straight front, side/back/interior or turn it into another Falconer design. All surface scars, panel lines, copper/bronze palette and source local light must follow the visible screenshot, with no new symbols, vents, fittings or speculative microdetail. Exclude all biological face/skin/mandibles below the rigid shell, dreadlocks, metal dread rings, neck, body/armor, shoulder weapon on image-right and any scene. Only mask-attached parts as source visible; do not attach the shoulder weapon to the mask. Preserve dark opaque lens/eye treatment versus true source openings; no living eyes. Exactly one complete isolated mask, genuine transparent RGBA, centered with 10 percent clear transparent margin on every side, longest axis only 78-80 percent of canvas. Whole crown and pointed muzzle unclipped. No shadow plane, floor, background, glow halo, UI, text or duplicate views. Preserve source game palette/rendering, no new artistic redesign. This is a camera-specific source-view candidate with fine relief limited by screenshot resolution, never automatic exact canon certification.
